scope: The scheduled appearance switch waits for Plasma at login and retries when the desktop becomes available.

checks.command: KDE neon Wayland guest, scheduled service before Plasma at 09:00, inspect saved Auto and exit 75, start display manager, observe automatic retry at 09:00:15 and light desktop.

approval: Maintainer requested release after reviewing the morning login fix.
coverage_limits: The morning login reproduction used the shared switcher with the Golden Gate wallpaper in KDE neon on Wayland. X11 and a separate Tahoe desktop were not exercised.
